moodys.citation_text: Moody's affirms Texas Children's Hospital's Aa2 and P-1; outlook stable.

sp.citation_text: S&P had AA rating on Texas Children's entering 2024 (subsequently downgraded to AA- in August 2024).

fitch.citation_text: Fitch had AA rating on Texas Children's prior to July 2024 downgrade to AA-.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's affirmed Aa2 with stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Decisive initiatives to drive recovery in fiscal 2025 following unexpected cash flow losses in 2024 due to material and largely temporary operating challenges
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's Ratings affirmed its Aa2 rating and stable outlook in July (2024), citing 'decisive initiatives to drive a strong and swift recovery in fiscal 2025.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch downgraded Texas Children's Hospital rating to AA- (from AA); stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Material underperformance in profitability driven by weaker than expected volumes in Houston market, delayed opening of new Austin inpatient facility, operating headwinds for health plan; operating loss of $198.1M through first six months of fiscal 2024
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch downgraded Texas Children's Hospital's rating to 'AA-' in July 2024.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P downgraded Texas Children's to AA-
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fiscal 2024 on track to be system's worst performing year on record
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings cut ratings for Houston-based Texas Children's to AA-minus with stable outlook in August (2024).

outcome_class_rationale: Fitch downgraded AA → AA- in July 2024 and S&P downgraded AA → AA- in August 2024 — one-notch down by two agencies. Moody's affirmed Aa2. Per schema, DOWNGRADE = exactly one notch down by one or two agencies. Not MULTI_DOWNGRADE because Moody's did not downgrade (the threshold for MULTI is two-notch by any agency OR one-notch by three).
